package bytesvalidation_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	service "example.com/bytesvalidation/gen/bytescheck"
	client "example.com/bytesvalidation/gen/http/bytescheck/client"
	server "example.com/bytesvalidation/gen/http/bytescheck/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

func TestRequestValidation(t *testing.T) {
	seen := make(chan *service.CheckPayload, 1)
	endpoints := &service.Endpoints{Check: func(_ context.Context, p any) (any, error) {
		seen <- p.(*service.CheckPayload)
		return nil, loom.Fault("observed")
	}}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	hs := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	defer hs.Close()
	cases := []struct {
		name, body, code, detail string
		status                   int
		called                   bool
	}{
		{"valid", "{\"data\":\"aGk=\",\"optional\":\"aGV5\",\"chain\":\"aGk=\",\"choice\":\"aGk=\",\"items\":[\"aGk=\"],\"lookup\":{\"key\":\"aGk=\"},\"nullable\":\"aGk=\",\"label\":\"hi\"}", "fault", "observed", 500, true},
		{"minimum", "{\"data\":\"aA==\"}", "invalid_length", "validation error", 400, false},
		{"maximum", "{\"data\":\"bG9uZw==\"}", "invalid_length", "validation error", 400, false},
		{"missing", "{}", "missing_field", "Missing required field: data", 400, false},
		{"null", "{\"data\":null}", "missing_field", "Missing required field: data", 400, false},
		{"enum", "{\"data\":\"aGk=\",\"choice\":\"bm8=\"}", "invalid_enum_value", "invalid value", 400, false},
		{"array", "{\"data\":\"aGk=\",\"items\":[\"aA==\"]}", "invalid_length", "validation error", 400, false},
		{"map", "{\"data\":\"aGk=\",\"lookup\":{\"key\":\"aA==\"}}", "invalid_length", "validation error", 400, false},
		{"nullable", "{\"data\":\"aGk=\",\"nullable\":\"aA==\"}", "invalid_length", "validation error", 400, false},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			response, err := http.Post(hs.URL+"/check", "application/json", strings.NewReader(tc.body))
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			body, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := response.Body.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			var problem struct {
				Code   string `json:"code"`
				Detail string `json:"detail"`
			}
			if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &problem); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if response.StatusCode != tc.status || problem.Code != tc.code || !strings.Contains(problem.Detail, tc.detail) {
				t.Errorf("status=%d problem=%s", response.StatusCode, body)
			}
			select {
			case got := <-seen:
				if !tc.called {
					t.Error("invalid request invoked service")
				}
				if string(got.Data) != "hi" || got.Defaulted != "hi" {
					t.Errorf("decoded payload=%+v", got)
				}
			default:
				if tc.called {
					t.Error("valid request did not invoke service")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestClientResponseValidation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		body  string
		valid bool
	}{
		{"{\"data\":\"aGk=\"}", true},
		{"{\"data\":\"aA==\"}", false},
		{"{\"data\":\"bG9uZw==\"}", false},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.body, func(t *testing.T) {
			hs := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
				w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				if _, err := io.WriteString(w, tc.body); err != nil {
					t.Error(err)
				}
			}))
			defer hs.Close()
			c := client.NewClient("http", strings.TrimPrefix(hs.URL, "http://"), hs.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
			_, err := c.Check()(t.Context(), &service.CheckPayload{Data: service.Blob("hi")})
			if (err == nil) != tc.valid {
				t.Errorf("error=%v want valid=%t", err, tc.valid)
			}
		})
	}
}
